podcast.body: Featured on "Road Apples," the song's title comes from the town of Trois-Pistoles, Quebec, situated on the southern shores of the St. Lawrence River. The narrative of the song revolves around Tom Thompson, an artist who influenced the Group of Seven and died at age 39 while canoeing in Algonquin Park, embodying a deeply Canadiana story. "The song itself is about Tom Thompson, an artist who would influence the group of seven, and who died at age 39 while canoeing through Algonquin Park."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
